title: Lumen Reach 0.9.0 -> 0.9.1: owner live-test findings at the exact poses
subtitle: Owner live 4K capture (0.9.0, their session) | private Intel nested 0.9.0 | nested 0.9.1; Medium 0.5 scale, core a2d39f9 (main, IPC 0.19), release packages (format 0.7).

rows.title: Sun Court arrival: "what's that black thing there"
rows.caption: The black slab left of the globe is the Signal mountain shell's silhouette ~150 m out: terrain had untextured roughness 1, so core's specular exponent is 0 and pow(0,0) gives NaN (black) where N.H<=0. 0.9.1: terrain roughness 0.95. The armillary rings (dark on one side from a 2-texel lightmap) now render unbaked ivory.

rows.title: Sun Court arrival, second angle
rows.caption: Same slab from a second pose (it moved with the view: a shading NaN, not an object). Gone in 0.9.1; rings read ivory all round.

rows.title: Sun Court wall: "the screen doesn't fit here, the text is in the roof"
rows.caption: 0.9.0: 18.8x9.3 m wall (2.02:1) letterboxed the 16:9 workspace; the "01 SUN COURT" plaque (top z 15.96) ran into the roof deck overhang (z 15.68). 0.9.1: true 16:9 16x9 m wall; sign 0.40 m at z 15.22, 0.18 m under the deck.

rows.title: Array Hall wall: "why were they not made in standard 4K ratios"
rows.caption: 0.9.0: 16x8 m (2:1). 0.9.1: 16x9 m, frame filled by the workspace; suspension rods and the "02 ARRAY HALL" plaque follow the taller frame.

rows.title: Workspace 21 on the sun-court primary wall (screens check still)
